hook.name: UnihoodStockHook
hook.description: A tokenized-stock Uniswap v4 hook that charges a fixed swap fee (0–5%, set at pool launch) split between creator (80%), a bid-wall budget (5%), and a platform treasury (15%). It auto-rebuilds a single-sided quote-token liquidity position below spot price using accumulated wall fees, and restricts external liquidity additions until the pool graduates past a configured tick.
